notebooks.title: 到达成本、KF与控制接口

cells.code:
y=[.2,1.4,1.1,.9,1.2];inputs=[.5,0,0,0]
filtered,priors=kf(y,inputs=inputs)
full,A,b=batch(y,inputs,.5,1.)
cut,Ac,bc=batch(y[2:],inputs[2:],*priors[2])
assert np.allclose(cut,full[2:],atol=1e-12)
assert np.isclose(full[-1],filtered[-1][0],atol=1e-12)
default_batch=original(default,False)['x'];default_filtered,_=kf(y[:3])
assert np.isclose(default_batch[-1],default_filtered[-1][0],atol=1e-12)
print('default_batch_current',default_batch[-1],'kf_current',default_filtered[-1][0],'past_smoothed',default_batch[0],'past_filtered',default_filtered[0][0])
print('arrival_at_time2',priors[2],'full_current',full[-1],'cut_current',cut[-1],'max_difference',max(abs(cut-full[2:])))
# Identical scalar observation counted once versus twice.
once_mean=.5;once_P=.5;K=once_P/(once_P+1);twice_mean=once_mean+K*(1-once_mean);twice_P=(1-K)*once_P
assert np.isclose(twice_mean,2/3) and np.isclose(twice_P,1/3)
print('one_measurement_once',once_mean,once_P,'twice',twice_mean,twice_P)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,3));ax.plot(range(5),y,'x',label='measurements');ax.plot(range(5),full,'o-',label='full batch smoothed');ax.plot(range(5),[z[0] for z in filtered],'o--',label='causal KF');ax.set(xlim=(0,4),ylim=(-1,3),xlabel='time',ylabel='level');ax.legend();ax.grid(True);plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('arrival_and_kf_checked')

from fractions import Fraction as F
x=[F(11,30),F(1),F(1)];H=[[F(9),F(-4),F(0)],[F(-4),F(12),F(-4)],[F(0),F(-4),F(8)]];rhs=[F(-7,10),F(38,5),F(22,5)]
gradient=[sum(H[i][j]*x[j] for j in range(3))-rhs[i] for i in range(3)]
assert gradient==[F(0),F(-16,15),F(-2,5)]
print('exact_kkt_gradient',[str(v) for v in gradient])
truth=F(3,2);estimate=F(1);reference=F(1);input_from_estimate=(reference-estimate)/F(11,10);input_from_truth=(reference-truth)/F(11,10)
print('estimate_based_input',float(input_from_estimate),'predicted_next',float(estimate+input_from_estimate),'actual_next',float(truth+input_from_estimate))
print('perfect_state_input',float(input_from_truth),'actual_next',float(truth+input_from_truth))
assert input_from_truth==F(-5,11) and truth+input_from_truth==F(23,22)
print('kkt_and_control_interface_checked')
